items.where: canal wing west of the brick part (a 11-32 m): grey glazed tile wall, eight rows on a 4.0 m pitch, per row one narrow (1.8 m) and four wide (3.4 m) white steel windows of many lights; low small windows on the ground floor
items.how: canalWing(): steelWindow per axis and row, 4 x 3 lights

items.where: lower brown brick part further east (a 32-49 m): tiled two-storey base with eight small and three wide windows, five windows per brick storey (double-tier on the 4th and 5th), a row of eight small windows under the parapet
items.how: brickPart(): tile base and brick walls as separate solids, steelWindow rows

items.where: continuous steel gallery with a light railing along the brick part at about 7 m, over the tiled base
items.how: concrete slab 1.1 m deep, posts every 1.4 m and a top rail in frame grey

items.where: recent glazed storey set back above the brick parapet (to 3DBAG 26 m)
items.how: white solid set back 2 m with a glass ribbon, ten mullions and a fascia

items.where: shallow rectangular glass erker running up most of the height at the east end, an entrance under it (RCE text)
items.how: glass solid 0.7 m proud from 3.3 to 27.4 m with floor bands, three mullions, dark door below

items.where: two small round windows at the junction of the brick part and the grey block
items.how: white ring frame with a glass disc

items.where: the glass corner box seen end-on at the west end of the crop
